description: Find EU legislation articles by meaning. Hits: law_id (CELEX), article_ref, law_title, score, snippet. An article_ref art_N is the articleId for lex_get_document; any other form (anx_N annex, rct_a-b recitals, par_N / j_N text windows) is not an article id, and lex_get_document include reads those parts. Consolidated hits (consolidated: true) are not the authentic text; baseCelex names the authentic act. asOf gives each hit the version listed for a date. For today's version, pass today's date (UTC) as asOf and use only hits with asOfResolved: true. Without asOf, acts no longer in force are marked inForce: false where their status is known; since-amended or repealed provisions are not marked. Cost: 5 credits; with asOf, plus up to 5 per version fetched live (at most 3 per request; failed fetches free).

asOf.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD, 1952-01-01 to today (UTC)). Resolved hits (asOfResolved: true, asOfVersion) carry the version listed for that date, which does not say whether a provision applied then. Unresolved hits keep the indexed text with an asOfReason, explained in asOfCaveat. Omitted: the indexed texts as they are (the act as published, or its latest consolidated version where indexed).

filters.description: Only language is read for legislation; any other key is an error here.

language.description: Same as the top-level language, which wins.

include.description: ["text"] returns the full matched article text instead of a ~600-character snippet.

language.description: Preferred language of the text (default en); acts without it come back in another language, labelled.

limit.description: Max hits (plan cap: FREE 10, STARTER 20, higher 50). Merged consolidated/base duplicates can make a page shorter.

maxChars.description: Character budget for hit texts when include is ["text"].

min_score.description: Similarity floor. Default ≈0.7 server-side; a lower value (e.g. 0.5) returns more hits, 0 disables it.

query.description: Natural-language description of the provision you are looking for.

name: lex_semantic_legislation
title: Semantic search over EU legislation
